notes.title: Post Next Fest Updates
notes.notes: [p]The Steam Next Fest has concluded. Thank you all for your support of [b][i]Long Knives[/i][/b]. Here's a brief data report: Over 3,100 players have added the [i]Long Knives Demo[/i] to their libraries, with more than 950 trying it out. During the event, the average daily active players were around 117. As of the morning of June 16, the wishlist count stands at approximately 1,520.[/p][p]All reported bugs have been fixed. Since the entire process, from design and development to operation and promotion, has been handled by a single individual (one biological person) in their spare time, oversights are inevitable. Some comments may not have received timely responses, and we apologize for that.[/p][p]Additionally, we've noticed that due to unclear information, some players couldn't find the feedback channels. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused. If you encounter any issues, please send details to long.knives.info@gmail.com.[/p][p]Once again, thank you for your support.[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix - June 14, 2025
notes.notes: [p]Since the start of Next Fest, we’ve received a lot of enthusiastic feedback from players, and we’re truly grateful. All feedback has been documented, but due to recent busy travels, we haven’t had time to respond—please forgive us for that.[/p][p]The current version update includes several major changes, such as:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Simplified Chinese players were incorrectly identified as Traditional Chinese upon launch.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a soft-lock issue in Chapter 1 and errors in triggering certain dialogues.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected typos and mistranslations in the prologue’s localization.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted visual effects to reduce flickering issues.[/p][/*][/list][p]If you encounter any problems during gameplay, you can email us at long.knives.info@gmail.com with details about your problems. We will reach out to you soon.[/p][p]Thank you for believing in us.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Next Fest & Localization
notes.notes:
[i][b]Long Knives[/b][/i] will appear in the Steam Next Fest in June.

We have released the polished Chapter 1, which is:
[list]
[*] Not with a new plot/mechanic at all
[*] Edited for better reading
[*] Upgraded with visual assets
[*] Offering support in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Korean
[/list]
Chapter 2 is done by now, but we are still testing it. The full version with Chapters 1 & 2 will be released before the Next Fest begins. The play time for Chapter is expected to be approximately 2 times longer than that of Chapter 1.

Thank you for your support.

notes.title: Demo will be available starting February 25, 2025
notes.notes:
The demo of [i][b]Long Knives[/b][/i] will be available for download starting February 25, 2025. This demo is expected to remain online indefinitely, even after the full game is released.

Since we need to gather feedback and further adjust the game system, the demo is being released somewhat early. If you want to experience the game rather than participate in testing, you may want to wait for more updates before downloading. We aim to fully refine the demo by June 2025, after which no further updates are expected.

The finalized demo will include Chapters 1 and 2 and saved data can be transferred to the full game.

Thank you for your support!
